description: Latest Korea Exchange (KRX) gold market close in KRW per gram and per don (3.75 g), from Financial Services Commission public data (posted one or more business days after trading — check trading_date), plus the USD/KRW base rate from the Export-Import Bank of Korea. Check is_past (refreshed around 07:10 KST) and next_update_kst. International spot-based won prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium are on the page (link in the result) and are not returned here.
name: gold_prices
title: Gold price in Korea (KRX gold market)
